_provenance.description: Assessment DEMO fixture. Contains 200 fuel station records selected from the provided fuel-prices-for-be-assessment.csv dataset. Coordinates are APPROXIMATE CORRIDOR PLACEMENTS produced by a deterministic pseudo-random perturbation of approximate per-state anchors. They are NOT genuine Nominatim address-level geocodes, and they are NOT city centroids. Use this fixture for the assessment Loom demo. For production-quality coordinates run the `geocode_stations` management command.
_provenance.coordinate_provenance: Deterministic pseudo-random perturbation of per-state anchor points. NOT sourced from any geocoding provider in this fixture.
_provenance.coordinate_count_warning: These coordinates are approximate only. Do not rely on them for real routing, site selection, or compliance use cases.
